answer: Fake accounts cost real capital plus unrecoverable attestation history, so a swarm of hollow identities drains funds without ever harvesting trust. Sybil resistance here rests on staked identity bonded to a public reputation trellis: each agent locks collateral, and peers attest work over epochs. Like seedlings on a tundra, only agents with genuine roots survive; the rest wither, unable to climb the trellis. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
